title: Avocado with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- outer avocado skin -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="30" ry="38" fill="#3a7a2a"/>
  <!-- lighter skin edge -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="28" ry="36" fill="#4e9e38"/>
  <!-- inner flesh -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="23" ry="31" fill="#d4e85a"/>
  <!-- lighter flesh highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="20" ry="27" fill="#e8f56e"/>
  <!-- pit -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="12" fill="#8b5e2a"/>
  <!-- pit highlight -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="59" r="4" fill="#a87a44"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="44" r="3.5" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="44" r="3.5" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <!-- eye glints -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="43" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="43" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M40 50 Q50 60 60 50" stroke="#2a1a0a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="49" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f5a0a0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="49" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#f5a0a0" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
